Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 4. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 5. Generic

Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 6. Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. 7. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 8. The Bidder should have experience in supplying of any equipment as per items of SOR to any Govt. Dep t. /PSU / Quasi Govt/ Private during the last 10 years. Relevant work order along with signed delivery challa ns by the buyer client of the bidder or GeM Consignee Receipt must be attached in the bid. Bidder shall pr oduce previous experience of supplying Min. 800 solar street lights. 2. The bidder should be an OEM (Original equipment Manufacturer) or an Authorized Dealer of OEM. Documentary evidence to be submitted in this regard. OEM should provide self-certification declaring self as manufacturer of the equipment. In case of OEM authorized dealer, dealer should submit the equipment authorization from OEM. 3. The bidder should have an authorized service Centre in Assam and same should be reflected from the s ubmitted documents Contract performance Security (CPS): Applicable.The Contract performance security (CPS) shall be 3% of t he GeM Contract value (as indicated in e-BG field in the GeM tender) to be submitted by successful bidder within 10 days of GeM Contract placement / award. Warranty Bank Guarantee (WBG): Applicable-The Warranty Bank Guarantee (WBG) shall be 7% (in additio n to CPS) of the GeM Contract value to be submitted by the successful bidder.

Delayed Delivery & Liquidated Damages-applicable. Payment Term Unless otherwise specified in Technical/Buyer Specification, payment term shall be as follows: 100% payment both against Supply Part and Installation Part respectively on pro-rata basis as per certifica tion of EIC within 30 days. Third Party Inspection (TPI): Applicable May refer to Technical Specification/Buyer specification document for NRL recommended/preferred TPI age ncy (if any) and for other relevant details. • Third-Party Inspection: A third-party inspection will be conducted to ensure that the delivered goods meet the required technical s pecifications and standards. a. The TPI (Third Party Inspection) will be in the scope of the bidder. b. The bidder will include the TPI charges in the overall quote. c. The bidder shall select any of the following agencies only for TPI: • TUV –Nord • BVIL • TUV-Sud • CEIL • Lloyds d. NRL representative will witness the TPI for which advance intimation will be given by the bidder to NRL. Guarantee/ Warranty: Applicable:Minimum 1 year from the date of installation. Delivery Schedule: The delivery period of the solar LED streetlights will be 12 (twelve) months from the date of placement of P .O. However, the lights shall be installed in phases in different places within India majority of which will be in Assam. Materials shall be delivered at the respective locations as per advice from NRL EIC. The delivery shall be in staggered lot as per requirement. The contractor shall supply, install, test and commission the items as pe r direction received from EIC, NRL. Notification of Locations: NRL will notify the vendor of the specific locations for the supply, installation, test ing & commissioning of each lot of solar street lights. Delivery Timeline: The vendor shall ensure that all solar street lights, along with their components and acc essories, are delivered to the designated project site within 04 (four) to 06 (six) weeks from the date of not ification by NRL. The party has to ensure all the supplied items are in working condition upon delivery of the items. The part y has to replace the damaged or partially working items at its own cost without any additional financial im plication to NRL. � Inspection on Delivery: Upon delivery, NRL will inspect the solar street lights and components to verify t heir quality and quantity, as well as to identify any damage incurred during transit. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS � PV Module : 12 V / 100 Wp Mono/ Poly C-Si Modules � Lithium Ferrous Phosphate (LiFePO4) ; Minimum battery capacity :12.8 V, 42 Ah

� Solar Charge Controller MPPT � Efficiency >=93% � Back Up Upto 24Hrs. with Dimming on fully charged battery & installed as per product manual instructions. � LED lamp: - White Light Emitting Diode (W-LED); 30 W output - LED Viewing Angle 120 Degree - Colour Temperature 6000K - Lumen output > = 5000 Lumens - Luminous Efficacy >= 135 Lumens (tolerance as per IS) - Life Span >= 50000 hours - Driver In Built DC- DC type - Duty Cycle :Automatic Dusk-to-dawn � Motion sensor control : Avaialble � Body: Aluminium Extruded Body with Mounting Frame Provided - Mounting of light : 6 meters Galvanized Iron (GI) Hot Dip Galvanized - Octagonal Pole mounted above ground level - Two Iron rods of minimum 8inch and thickness 12mm to be provided under the ground passing through the pole to provide extra support and stability and protection from pilferage. - Baseplate of size 300mm X 450mm X 8mm (thick) must be provided. � Dust and Water Protection IP 65 � Low-Voltage indication Red � Charging indication Green � Other Protections a. Over-Charge Protection b. Deep-Discharge Protection c. Over Current Protection d. Short Circuit Protection e. Over Voltage Protection � Electronics: Overall total Efficiency of the electronics Minimum 90%, � Dusk to dawn operation: To be provided � Humidity range 0 to 95 % (non-condensing) � Temperature range -10 to +55 °C � Motion Sensor Control To be provided
